```{r}
# 使用county数据集合成的MMSA poverty数据重新拟合+预测：
data <- read.csv('../data for modeling/brfss_2019_ready_to_fit_model.csv')
#data <- read.csv('../data for modeling/brfss_2021_ready_to_fit_model.csv')
str(data)
data$AGE <- as.factor(data$AGE)
data$SEX <- as.factor(data$SEX)
data$RACE <- as.factor(data$RACE)
data$MENTLE <- as.factor(data$MENTLE)
data$MMSA <- as.factor(data$X_MMSA)
data$STATE <- as.factor(data$STATE)
# 未考虑权重的模型：
model <- glmmTMB(MENTLE ~ AGE + SEX + RACE + PER_LOWPOVERTY + (1 | MMSA)  + (1 | STATE), data = data, family = binomial)
summary(model)
```

处理预测数据
```{r}
#race_year <- "white_2015"
data_p <- data_p_2021
year <- 2021
str(data_p)
data_p$AGE <- as.factor(data_p$AGEG5YR)
data_p$SEX <- as.factor(data_p$X_SEX)
data_p$RACE <- as.factor(data_p$X_MRACE1)
data_p$MMSA <- as.factor(data_p$X_MMSA)
data_p$STATE <- as.factor(data_p$STATE)
# 蒙特卡洛
# Extract the fixed effect estimates and variance-covariance matrix
fixef_est <- fixef(model)$cond
vcov_est <- vcov(model)$cond

# Function to generate predictions based on sampled parameters
generate_predictions <- function(fixef_sample, newdata) {
  # Create a model matrix from newdata
  X <- model.matrix(~ AGE + SEX + RACE + PER_LOWPOVERTY, data = newdata)
  # Calculate the linear predictor
  eta <- X %*% fixef_sample
  # Convert to predicted probabilities
  pred_prob <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
  return(pred_prob)
}
# Prepare an empty matrix to store the predictions
n <- nrow(data_p)
predictions_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = 1000)
# Monte Carlo simulation with 5 rounds
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
for (i in 1:1000) {
  # Draw a sample of the fixed effects parameters
  fixef_sample <- MASS::mvrnorm(1, mu = fixef_est, Sigma = vcov_est)
  # Generate predictions
  predictions_matrix[, i] <- generate_predictions(fixef_sample, data_p)
}
# Compute the mean predictions for each observation (each census block)
mean_predictions <- rowMeans(predictions_matrix)
# Calculate the standard error of the predictions for each observation
se_predictions <- apply(predictions_matrix, 1, sd) / sqrt(5)
# Compute the 95% confidence intervals
alpha <- 0.05
z_score <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
lower_bound <- mean_predictions - z_score * se_predictions
upper_bound <- mean_predictions + z_score * se_predictions
# Combine the results into a data frame
prediction_results <- data.frame(
  Observation = 1:nrow(data_p),
  Mean_Prediction = mean_predictions,
  SE_Prediction = se_predictions,
  Lower_CI = lower_bound,
  Upper_CI = upper_bound
)
data_p$predicted_risk <- prediction_results[,2]
# print(data_p)
write.csv(data_p, paste0("../health_after_prediction/MH_CB_prediction_",year,".csv"))
```
